entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Hit assertion in `MemberSemanticModel.GuardedAddBoundTreeForStandaloneSyntax` #80618
  • Test plan for "collection expression arguments" feature #80613
  • `CopyRefAssembly` Task takes quite a long time even on incremental builds #80611
  • Toolset compiler package on .NET Framework should use .NET Core compiler #80608
    Next
  • How to obtain the CSharp language version in the Register Post Initialization Output method of IIncreatingGenerator. #80604
  • Remove references to deprecated testing packages #80602

Closed

  • Hit assertion in `LocalRewriter.CollectAndVisitConcatArguments` #80616
  • [SuppressMessage] doesn't work for [Experimental] or [Obsolete] #80607
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-11108.236 #80606
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11108.29 #80599

PullRequests

Created

  • Make string concat assert more precise #80619
    Area-Compilers
  • Add IDE/Compiler specific custom instructions #80617
  • Use proper "unsafe" context while binding type in explicit interface specifier #80610
    Area-Compilers
  • Add XML doc comments to Incremental Generator public API #80609
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • PEDeltaAssemblyBuilder: Don't freeze `_needsGeneratedAttributes` compilation state. #80600
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Add copilot instructions file #80615
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Avoid double-delete when racing on deleted directory #80582
    Area-Analyzers, Next
  • Remove main merge workflow #80614
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Restore PROTOTYPE comment in bound nodes #80612
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (2). #80554
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Fix exception thrown from background work indicator #80605
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Update status of Collection expression arguments #80543
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • MS.CA.VB resources cleanup #80098
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • More MS.CA.CSharp resource cleanup #80100
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80603
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Fix crash getting options for a diagnostic suppressor #80592

Updated

  • Ensure `LspWorkspaceManager` returns solutions without misc document when file moved #80535
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers
  • Warn for redundant pattern in `not ... or <redundant>` pattern #75581
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Disable CS8002 warning when targeting .NET Core #80596
  • Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (3). #80568
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Add a test for collection expression with ref struct element type #80593
    Area-Compilers
  • Further clean up Roslyn's package load #80598
    Area-IDE
  • Add snap script #80591
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add limited support for binarylogger to MSBuildWorkspace #80120
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve detection of invalid references for implicitly typed expression variables declared within implicit object creation expressions. #80546
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Target-Typed New
  • Convert Roslyn.sln to slnx #80440
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
